item.title: Axelera Europa
item.description: Axelera AI launched its Europa AI processing unit on September 15, 2026, quadrupling the memory of its earlier Metis chip to 64GB and rating it at up to 629 TOPS of INT8 performance. Eight second-generation AI cores use Axelera’s digital in-memory-compute design to cut the energy cost of moving data, backed by two clusters of RISC-V vector cores handling non-AI pre- and post-processing, 128MB of L2 SRAM, and 200 Gbps of DRAM bandwidth.
